card.name: The or leading before ranking statements
card.fires_on: The word "the" or "leading" right after "is/are/was/a" when a sentence is about to rank something, as in "the most common", "the second-largest", "a leading cause".

modes.label: Superlative setup
modes.description: "the" after a form of "to be" that leads into most/number one/largest.
modes.example: Asthma is<< the>> number one reason children miss school due to

modes.label: Leading cause
modes.description: "leading" in "a leading cause" of a harm or condition.
modes.example: WARNING: Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a<< leading>> cause of fatal poisoning in children under

modes.label: Rank or comparison
modes.description: Words like "#", "alone" or "with" in rankings and population comparisons.
modes.example: Los Angeles County<< alone>> is more populous than 42 individual

card.writes: It suppresses count and total words such as number, total and share, so the sentence goes on with a ranking word instead.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a sentence calls something the biggest, most common or leading.
